panels.scene: The sun sets over the field. The weary farmer walks home along a dusty path, his tools resting on his shoulder.
panels.greekCaption: ὀψία ἐστίν. ὁ γεωργὸς ἐπιστρέφει ἀπὸ τοῦ ἀγροῦ.
panels.englishCaption: It is evening. The farmer returns from the field.
panels.imageDescription: A farmer walking home at sunset, silhouetted against the orange sky, carrying farming tools

panels.scene: Inside his house, the farmer washes his hands and feet. The table is set with bread and wine.
panels.greekCaption: εἰσέρχεται εἰς τὴν οἰκίαν. ἡ τράπεζα ἑτοίμη ἐστίν.
panels.englishCaption: He enters the house. The table is ready.
panels.imageDescription: The interior of a simple home: a wooden table with bread and a clay cup of wine, a lamp casting warm light

panels.scene: The farmer bows his head over the bread. His lips move in quiet prayer of thanks to God.
panels.greekCaption: λαμβάνει τὸν ἄρτον καὶ εὐχαριστεῖ τῷ θεῷ.
panels.englishCaption: He takes the bread and gives thanks to God.
panels.imageDescription: A man with bowed head, hands holding bread, eyes closed in prayer at a simple table

panels.scene: Night falls. The farmer lights the lamp. Warm light fills the house. He rests peacefully, knowing God keeps watch.
panels.greekCaption: νύξ ἐστίν. ὁ θεὸς φυλάσσει αὐτόν. ἡ εἰρήνη τοῦ θεοῦ μένει ἐν τῇ καρδίᾳ αὐτοῦ.
panels.englishCaption: It is night. God watches over him. The peace of God abides in his heart.
panels.imageDescription: A lamp glowing on a windowsill at night, stars visible outside, the farmer resting peacefully within
